Legal

Privacy Policy

How this website handles information — plainly stated.

What this website collects

This website is a public information service. It does not require accounts, does not use tracking cookies and does not store personal data on this site. The contact form prepares an email using your own device's email application; your message is delivered by your email provider to MASLOC and is not stored by this website.

Server logs

Like most websites, the hosting provider may record standard technical logs (such as IP address, browser type, requested pages and timestamps) for security and reliability purposes. These logs are governed by the hosting provider's own policies.

Third-party links

This website links to official MASLOC social media channels and mapping services. Those sites have their own privacy policies, which we encourage you to read.

Search

The site search runs entirely in your browser. Search terms are not sent to any server operated for this website.

Requests

To ask about any information this site may hold, contact info@masloc.gov.gh or write to the Head Office, 29 Third Circular Road, Cantonments, Accra.

This policy must be reviewed and formally approved by MASLOC's legal officers before launch (see MISSING-CONTENT.md).

MASLOC is the Government of Ghana institution providing microcredit, small loans and enterprise development services to start-ups, small businesses and entrepreneurs nationwide.
